note: 第二单元本批的派生、拓展及隔离素材。原书真题标签未核实年份；不直接计入主词进度。

items.label: 真题
items.english: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests.
items.translation: 州政府对森林治理驾轻就熟。

items.label: 例
items.english: She’s very conventional in her views.
items.translation: 她的观点很守旧。

items.label: 例
items.english: A bicycle is often more convenient than a car in towns.
items.translation: 在城镇骑自行车常常比开车更方便。

items.label: 真题
items.english: If you’re not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
items.translation: 如果花一年的时间去探索兴趣的内在价值还不足以令你信服，那么考虑一下它对未来学业选择的经济影响吧。
items.reason: be convinced of为确信的状态用法；先隔离待独立词义映射，不直接计入使确信动词进度。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Fossil fuels—coal, oil, gas—still generate roughly 85 percent of the world’s energy supply.
items.translation: 化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍占世界能源供应的85%左右。

items.label: 真题
items.english: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.
items.translation: 在新大陆的历史中，被研究得最彻底的学者是17世纪新英格兰的牧师和政治领袖们。

items.label: 例
items.english: Training is absolutely essential in this business.
items.translation: 在这个行业中，培训是绝对必要的。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Many of us are weighed down by the past or anxious about the future.
items.translation: 我们中的大多数人都被过去压得喘不过气来，或者对未来感到焦虑。

items.label: 例
items.english: He showed a remarkable ignorance of the facts.
items.translation: 他对这些事实表现得一无所知。

items.label: 例
items.english: The company says the cost of relocation will be negligible.
items.translation: 公司说搬迁的费用微不足道。

items.label: 例
items.english: Different people have different conceptions.
items.translation: 不同的人有不同的理解。

items.label: 例
items.english: You have spent your life in idleness.
items.translation: 你一生都在无所事事中度过。

items.word: the common practice of recruiting players from all over the world
items.label: 拓展
items.definition: 从世界各地招募球员的常见做法

items.label: 真题
items.english: It’s a stunning move.
items.translation: 这是一个惊人之举！
items.reason: stunning为形容词用法，未作为stun的动词学习卡。

items.label: 例
items.english: The cottage is tiny, but it’s charming.
items.translation: 这间村舍虽小，却十分迷人。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance.
items.translation: 他相信，优雅并不源于富足。

items.label: 例
items.english: The dancers were all tall and graceful.
items.translation: 这些舞蹈演员都个子高高的，动作十分优雅。

items.label: 例
items.english: He spoke of her performance in the film in glowing terms.
items.translation: 他热烈赞扬了她在影片中的表演。

items.label: 真题
items.english: The final, polished work that he gave to the world was the result of years of practising, re-practising, re-writing and reading.
items.translation: 最终他留给世界的作品是经过精雕细琢的，是多年练习、重写和阅读的结果。
items.reason: polished work的精雕细琢为引申形容词义，原书未列；待另行映射。

items.label: 真题
items.english: With much practice people can learn to, literally, do it in their sleep.
items.translation: 经过大量的练习，人们真的可以学会在睡梦中做这件事。

items.label: 例
items.english: We scarcely ever meet.
items.translation: 我们难得见一面。

items.label: 例
items.english: Provide extra health compensation.
items.translation: 提供额外的健康补偿。

items.label: 例
items.english: He spoke fluently and without unnecessary hesitations.
items.translation: 他说得很流畅，毫不支吾。

items.label: 真题
items.english: As science and technology progressed, and divided into more subdisciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.
items.translation: 随着科学技术的进步，且分化出更多的分支学科，该中心同时期待着这样一个时代，即一流的研究者也可能成为艺术家、作家和诗人，反之亦然。

items.label: 例
items.english: What she said is a matter of complete indifference to me.
items.translation: 她的话对我来说完全无关紧要。

items.label: 例
items.english: Anything was preferable to the tense atmosphere at home.
items.translation: 什么都比家里的紧张气氛好。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Thinking too much can also harm our ability to form preferences.
items.translation: 想太多也会损害我们形成爱好的能力。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Another approach to getting more done in less time is to rethink how you prioritise your day.
items.translation: 在更少的时间内完成更多工作的另一方法就是重新考虑一天中事情孰轻孰重。

items.label: 例
items.english: She wears a fashionable hair style prevailing in the city.
items.translation: 她的发型是这个城市流行的款式。
